hypothesis: A tied learned controller with a differentiable LIFO stack can discover reusable latent input organization and output traversal without mutable addressing or output autoregression.
correction_history: Before submission, the T64 fixture was corrected to encode two T digits, exact state drift was asserted, generic output placement used batch matrix multiplication, and current-X presence was updated after each macrostep. The fixed stack mechanism did not change.
conclusion: The stack model completed the exposure gate but produced only 1/512 on each T1 profile. Learned LIFO organization did not create the required reusable transition.
limitation: One Easy E5 seed and one exact stack contract; this stops that mechanism, not all differentiable data structures.
no_retry_history: Do not retry stack size, controller width, action order, learning rate, batch, or seed. Advance to exact sum-product latent-state inference.
